g.text: M1 TIMER0: PA8/9/10 AF1; PB13/14 AF2, PB15 AF1. BRKIN PB12 AF4.

g.desc: M1 TIMER0: PA8/9/10 AF1; PB13/14 AF2, PB15 AF1. BRKIN PB12 AF4.

g.text: M2 TIMER7: PC6/7 AF3, PC8 AF2; PC0/1/2 AF0. BRKIN PA6 AF4.

g.desc: M2 TIMER7: PC6/7 AF3, PC8 AF2; PC0/1/2 AF0. BRKIN PA6 AF4.

g.text: M1 currents PA0/1/2; M2 currents PA3/4/5 (ADC0/ADC1).

g.desc: M1 currents PA0/1/2; M2 currents PA3/4/5 (ADC0/ADC1).

g.text: IBUS: PC3 / PC5; VBUS PC4; NTC PE7 / PE8 (ADC2).

g.desc: IBUS: PC3 / PC5; VBUS PC4; NTC PE7 / PE8 (ADC2).

g.text: Hall M1 PB4/5/0 TIMER2; M2 PD12/13/14 TIMER3. Release PB4 JTAG, keep SWD.

g.desc: Hall M1 PB4/5/0 TIMER2; M2 PD12/13/14 TIMER3. Release PB4 JTAG, keep SWD.

g.text: Shared SPI2 PC10/11/12 AF2; GPIO chip selects PE2 / PE3.

g.desc: Shared SPI2 PC10/11/12 AF2; GPIO chip selects PE2 / PE3.

g.text: VA/VB/VC/COM and M2_VBUS stay on power-sheet testpoints, not MCU ADC.

g.desc: VA/VB/VC/COM and M2_VBUS stay on power-sheet testpoints, not MCU ADC.

g.text: Verify Cs, startup margin and drive level on PCB; tune capacitors. Internal Rf=400k.

g.desc: Verify Cs, startup margin and drive level on PCB; tune capacitors. Internal Rf=400k.

g.text: Onboard debugger: HSLink page; R8901..R8905 are default-open.

g.desc: Onboard debugger: HSLink page; R8901..R8905 are default-open.

g.text: J200 external probe: never use simultaneously with onboard probe.

g.desc: J200 external probe: never use simultaneously with onboard probe.

g.text: USART1 bridge PD5/TX, PD6/RX; target must be powered before enabling links.

g.desc: USART1 bridge PD5/TX, PD6/RX; target must be powered before enabling links.

g.text: MCU_VDDA = VCC through R203 (0R), bypass C206..C208 to AGND.

g.desc: MCU_VDDA = VCC through R203 (0R), bypass C206..C208 to AGND.

g.text: AVCC LDO remains for external analog amplifiers only.

g.desc: AVCC LDO remains for external analog amplifiers only.

g.text: FAULT inputs use pullups; external open-drain HEALTH holds LOW only while healthy.

g.desc: FAULT inputs use pullups; external open-drain HEALTH holds LOW only while healthy.

g.text: Configure each timer break polarity HIGH; unplugged defaults to brake. No autonomous trip comparator fitted.

g.desc: Configure each timer break polarity HIGH; unplugged defaults to brake. No autonomous trip comparator fitted.

g.text: Current limits/thresholds and external fault source remain to be designed.

g.desc: Current limits/thresholds and external fault source remain to be designed.

g.text: Buttons PD2/PD3/PD4 active-low. See Interface page.

g.desc: Buttons PD2/PD3/PD4 active-low. See Interface page.

g.text: OLED1.29: I2C0 PB6 AF1 SCL / PB7 AF1 SDA.

g.desc: OLED1.29: I2C0 PB6 AF1 SCL / PB7 AF1 SDA.
